27:t_1:88.en:
$$かなめ$$
「You've been frozen for about ten minutes now... Is writing down your career plan really that hard?」

27:t_1:90.en:
$$かなめ$$
(Look... I think anything is fine for now. You can always change it later, you know.)

27:t_1:91.en:
$$宗介$$
(I can't even write that 'anything for now'...)

27:t_1:92.en:
$$かなめ$$
(Go to college, get a job, I think anything is fine...)

27:t_1:93.en:
$$宗介$$
(I don't really understand any of those... Writing something I don't understand...)

27:t_1:94.en:
$n
「Hurry up, $$宗介$$. Morning homeroom is about to start.」

27:t_1:95.en:
$$かなめ$$
「What did you write on your survey, $n?」

27:t_1:96.en:
$n
「I wrote that I'd follow in my old man's footsteps.」

27:t_1:97.en:
$$かなめ$$
「So that means... a 《$$ビーストハンター$$》?」

27:t_1:99.en:
$$かなめ$$
「But, you know... if that happens, you'll have to leave Japan, won't you?」

27:t_1:100.en:
$n
「I'd probably have to. Most Beast appearance points are on the North American continent.」

27:t_1:104.en:
$n
「Lately... I haven't been able to get in touch much.」

27:t_1:105.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I-it can't be helped, can it? Nurses seem to be busy and all.」

27:t_1:106.en:
$$宗介$$
「There's also a possibility that someone is jamming the signal.」

27:t_1:107.en:
$$かなめ$$
(Still comforting people in completely the wrong way...)

27:t_1:108.en:
$n
「...It's fine. I'll go visit the hospital after school.」

27:t_1:109.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Come to think of it, I heard that 《$$シンヤ#keyword$$》 and 《$$ミサコ#keyword$$》 have been discharged from the hospital... Are you in touch with those kids?」

27:t_1:110.en:
$n
「...No need. If they've been freed from the 《$$血塗られた眼$$》, that's all that matters.」

27:t_1:112.en:
$$アルト$$
「$n and the rest of us have all finished writing. Hurry up, $$宗介$$.」

27:t_1:114.en:
$$小野Ｄ$$
「I know how you feel, $$相良$$. With the likes of the $$新地球皇国$$ running wild, nobody can think about the future.」

27:t_1:115.en:
$$恭子$$
「You're right. We need the $$連邦軍$$ to work harder.」

27:t_1:116.en:
$$アルト$$
(Out of fear of panic, citizens in areas away from the front aren't told the reality of the $$新地球皇国$$ or the state of the war...)

27:t_1:117.en:
$$甲児$$
(For the people of Japan, the war is still something far away, huh...)

27:t_1:121.en:
$$スズネ$$
「It looks like no one from the Volunteer Club is absent, either.」

27:t_1:122.en:
$$恭子$$
「It's been a while, Miss $$スズネ$$.」

27:t_1:123.en:
$$詩織$$
「Thank you for your hard work on the Volunteer Club activities.」

27:t_1:124.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Thank you. I'm relieved to see that all of you look well, too.」

27:t_1:125.en:
$$小野Ｄ$$
「Though there's one guy over here sweating bullets.」

27:t_1:127.en:
$$恵理$$
「Your career plan survey, huh... It's admirable that you're taking your own future that seriously.」

27:t_1:128.en:
$$宗介$$
「I intend to give it my all...」

27:t_1:130.en:
$$恵理$$
「Whose phone was that? School rules say phones must be turned off while you're at school.」

27:t_1:131.en:
$$アルト$$
「Sorry, Teacher. $$早乙女アルト$$, leaving early due to family circumstances.」

27:t_1:132.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「Going alone would be rough, $$アルト$$. I'll come along.」

27:t_1:133.en:
$$甲児$$
「I'll bring out my bike. $$さやか$$, call us a taxi.」

27:t_1:134.en:
$$さやか$$
「Got it. $$ボス$$, you and the others bring everyone's bags.」

27:t_1:137.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Ms. $$神楽坂$$...! I'll go and find out what's going on from them!」

27:t_1:138.en:
$$スズネ$$
「$l and $$相良$$, help out too.」

27:t_1:140.en:
$$宗介$$
「I will submit my career plan survey as quickly as possible.」

27:t_1:142.en:
$$恭子$$
「In the end, every single Volunteer Club member left, huh...」

27:t_2:4.en:
$$レナード$$
「I don't even need to ask. The force we sent to $$第２新東京市$$ was wiped out, wasn't it?」

27:t_2:6.en:
$$レナード$$
「I never thought we would win, not from the start. Not even against them as they are now.」

27:t_2:7.en:
$$レナード$$
「But we accomplished our objective.」

27:t_2:9.en:
$$レナード$$
「It was my own way of declaring war. On $$テレサ$$ and them.」

27:t_2:10.en:
$$レナード$$
(The preparations will be ready soon... Once that's done, I'll go and get her.)

27:t_2:11.en:
$$レナード$$
(If possible, I'd like it to be a rainy day.)

27:t_2:18.en:
$$宗介$$
「I apologize for failing to submit the career plan survey, which was due today, before the deadline.」

27:t_2:19.en:
$$恵理$$
「It can't be helped. I heard from Ms. $$西条$$ that you got caught up in the fighting while chasing after $$早乙女#macross$$.」

27:t_2:20.en:
$$恵理$$
「I'm glad for $$早乙女#macross$$, too. I heard his father collapsed, but it doesn't sound like it was anything serious.」

27:t_2:21.en:
$$宗介$$
「Yes, ma'am... I am also carrying a message from $$アルト$$ apologizing for causing you concern.」

27:t_2:22.en:
$$宗介$$
「Furthermore, although it is an abbreviated format, allow me to report my career path verbally.」

27:t_2:24.en:
$$宗介$$
「My future objective is to graduate from this $$陣代高校$$. That is all.」

27:t_2:25.en:
$$恵理$$
「Well, you see... $$相良$$... What I want to know is what comes after that...」
